title: Blitch backs Randy Anderson's Crane story after Grusch introduction
place_text: Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, Indiana

tellings.quote: uh I I I believe every aspect of his story

plain: A scientist named John Blitch, who worked for DARPA, the Pentagon's advanced research agency, says he believes "every aspect" of a story told by a man named Randy Anderson about Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, a Navy research base in Indiana. Blitch tells Michels he met Anderson through David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who has testified that the government holds UFO secrets. What Anderson's story was, Blitch does not spell out here, but his backing lends it the word of someone from inside the defense world.
